title: Cart arrow is misplaced after the Font Awesome update
severity_source: Agent triage: visual alignment; actions remain usable.
user_acceptance: User accepted the centered arrow ('very nice') and requested ticket closure and commit.
source: User screenshot codex-clipboard-1f19ea8e-22dd-433b-babc-12e1e2dc1fb3.png: On new cart the arrow is miss placed.
trigger: Reveal the new cart feedback during a horizontal item swipe, including the mirrored left-swipe cart.
actual: The arrow sits left of the new basket center in the supplied mirrored example; the non-mirrored direction has the opposite offset. The user then reported that the final arrow position was too low (screenshot codex-clipboard-31f67d93-541a-412f-a317-5f5ad209473e.png).
expected: The whole arrow finishes at the horizontal and vertical center of the basket, rather than merely keeping its tip above the basket floor.
cause: CartInIcon and CartOutIcon retained asymmetric .42/.23 padding and a height/4 basket position tailored to the previous cart glyph.
implementation: Inherit ArrowIcon's symmetric .32/.32 padding. Set CartIn's destination and CartOut's matching starting position to height * 0.1875. This centers the actual arrow ink vertically in the basket. Shared ArrowIcon, sizes, animation timing and gesture thresholds are unchanged.
followup: User screenshot codex-clipboard-768960a2-a0f1-4669-ad53-b9ba0e498f42.png rejected the height/8 result: the whole arrow should finish in the middle of the cart. The previous tip-only assertion did not establish that requirement. User accepted the refined center position on 2026-11-08.

regression.coverage: 16 actual pixel cases: CartIn/CartOut, left/right, Light/Dark and preview scales 1/2. Compare the horizontal arrow centroid and vertical ink-bounds midpoint to the rendered basket center at the real arrival/departure position; retain the floor assertion, then pull back and verify no action.
regression.before: All 16 fail with the legacy padding; native Windows sample arrow center 39.59 versus basket 33.375. Report: out/fontawesome/cart-alignment-before.txt.
regression.after: All 16 alignment cases pass with native Windows rendering. After adding the endpoint assertion, all 16 fail with the old height/4 position and pass with height/8; both normal arrow CTest entries pass. Reports: cart-endpoint-before.txt, cart-endpoint-after.txt and windows-endpoint-regressions.txt under out/fontawesome. Earlier four arrow/contrast entries also pass (windows-cart-regressions.txt).
regression.android_before: Actual mirrored light-in-left profile fails: arrow center about 1317.7 versus basket 1335.65 pixels. Both first and repeated swipe are misaligned; saved data remains unchanged. Report: out/fontawesome/android-cart-before/results.json.
regression.android_endpoint_before: After horizontal centering, the actual settled mirrored arrow tip remains at pixel 255, below the basket floor at 254; both first and repeated swipes fail. Report: out/fontawesome/android-endpoint-before/results.json.
regression.android_after: The initial height/8 result passed the tip-only assertion (android-endpoint-after/results.json), but did not establish whole-arrow centering.
regression.middle_before: All 16 native Windows center assertions fail with height/8: out/fontawesome/cart-middle-before.txt. Actual Android first/repeated settled arrows also fail: arrow midpoint 204.5 versus basket midpoint 216.5 pixels, despite the tip being above the floor. Report: out/fontawesome/android-middle-before/results.json.
regression.middle_after: Both normal Windows arrow entries pass (30 records each, including 16 midpoint cases): out/fontawesome/windows-middle-regressions.txt. All ten Android profiles pass: out/fontawesome/android-middle-after/results.json. Settled arrow midpoint is 217.5 versus basket midpoint 216.5 pixels. The tests compare actual rendered midpoints with a maximum 2.5%-of-icon-size tolerance, independently of the chosen animation value.
regression.packages: Both ABIs rebuilt and pass their payload contracts (out/fontawesome/package-arm64-middle.json and package-x86-middle.json). ARM64 debug APK signed with the shared key and signature verified. Hashes: out/fontawesome/apk-middle-hashes.json. QML formatter check and Python compile check pass.

limitations: Automated rendering verified on Windows and native Android emulator. User accepted the final appearance; their confirmation did not specify the device.
